card.name: Start of brand names after 'with'
card.fires_on: The first piece of a brand or company name that is split into several parts, such as Unit in Unituxin, Multi in MultiHance, Ch in Chiesi, or & in Merck & Co. It appears right after words like 'with', 'of', 'received' or 'Contact'.
